basic_info.description: Stunning Northslope Home with Panoramic Views. Experience luxury living in one of Northslope's best locations! This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home enjoys a floor-to-ceiling transformation, featuring a spacious primary suite and exquisite limestone baths. Enjoy the elegance of hardwood floors, marble kitchen countertops, beautiful cabinetry, and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances. A custom wood-burning fireplace adds warmth and charm, with stylish light fixture sand  fresh interior paint. The home is bathed in natural light. This home also includes two-car parking with one space in the garage and one on the driveway pad, a rare find! Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to own a piece of prime Northslope real estate.
